resolved_or_scoped_items.evidence: Parser requires CASE exactly19 and OBS exactly6 REAL32 words.
Each case verifies T/QV/QC, EOS/selected rho, explicit raw number formula, mode/constants, inactive ice/snow outputs; wrong-input-arm tamper is rejected.

snapshot requires actual native Thompson initializer obmr and flag-setting anchors before inserting bridge. Test bridge initializes only private flag/exponent; thompson_init remains zero and mode labels explicitly refer to kernel state.

Report limits explicitly state Python binary64 pow/division with REAL32 operands is tolerance-bounded, not exact native-kind/ULP replay; assertion wording now bounded source-association. Relative2e-6/3e-6 remains declared.
Report states Thompson mass/number cancellation requires same gamma shape; high-number arms change shape. Cases3/4 share mu15. This does not infer universal density invariance.

remaining_limits: Full modules compile with dependency stubs and --gc-sections; no full WRF host/model/transport initialization or forecast is tested.
Bridge baseline is the actual helper with narrowly seeded private kernel state, not an uninitalized Thompson module and not thompson_init.
Cloud-only arms exclude ice/snow physics and radiation optics.
UDM raw NC slope versus rho-weighted activity gate is observed without deciding host unit authority or correcting the formula.
Conditional volume-number inputs remain declared hypotheses.
Thompson moment oracle assumes spherical liquid mass and generalized gamma PSD; matching this algebra does not prove physical PSD/LUT compatibility.
Bounds comparison and finite output guards exclude clamped/non-discriminating selected cases, but general cap/floor branches are not covered.
No cross-optimization bitwise equality or exact native-power implementation claim is made.
